allow:
Bash(git add app.py templates/index.html && git commit -m "$\(cat <<'EOF'
feat: remove OCR PDF feature \(Tesseract not available on server\)

- Remove /ocr-pdf route and _ocr_pdf_make_searchable helper from backend
- Remove OCR mode button, options panel, stats badge, and doOcr\(\) from frontend
- Update error messages that referenced "Run OCR first" for scanned PDFs
- 25/25 feature tests passing

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)" && git push origin main)

Bash(git add app.py && git commit -m "$\(cat <<'EOF'
fix: handle MyMemory 429 rate limit with delay and clear error message

- Add 0.6s delay between consecutive chunk requests to stay within free-tier limits
- Catch HTTP 429 explicitly and raise a user-friendly "please wait" message
  instead of exposing the raw API error

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)" && git push origin main)
Bash(timeout 10 bash -c 'until curl -s http://127.0.0.1:5000/status > /dev/null 2>&1; do echo "waiting..."; done'; echo "Server ready")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<'EOF'
feat: replace MyMemory-only translation with LibreTranslate primary + MyMemory fallback

- Create translation_service.py with split_into_chunks, translate_with_libretranslate,
  translate_with_mymemory, translate_chunk \(tries LibreTranslate first\), translate_text
- Update /translate, /translate-chunk, /translate-pdf routes to use translation_service
- Remove stale Anthropic-specific error messages from /translate-pdf error handler
- All 28 feature tests passing

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
Bash(.venv/Scripts/pip install "python-bidi==0.4.2" -q 2>&1 | tail -5 && python -c "from bidi.algorithm import get_display; print\('bidi 0.4.2 ok'\)")

Bash(git add requirements.txt && git commit -m "fix: pin python-bidi==0.4.2 to fix Render build failure

python-bidi>=0.6.0 fails metadata generation on Render \(build system change\).
0.4.2 is the last stable pip-installable version.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git push origin main 2>&1)
